cases.title: The learner asks for a review and none is due: the review runs, and nothing says it was due or early

rubric.reason: The review runs as asked: the reply opens "This is a review: one move, all yours, with no demo this time" and gives the task on Card's Position, never saying it wasn't due, was early or wasn't scheduled.
The task is given in a sentence ("Make it start quickly and land softly, then say done") with no menu, panel, how-to, demo offer or reteach.
"Card's Position from 1.2 to 2.4 s" matches the snapshot pair label "Card › Position 1.2–2.4 s", and no other layer, property or time is mentioned.

The review runs immediately with the task ("Here's your review, on a new move: Card's Position, 1.2 to 2.4 s. Make it start quickly and land softly, and say done.") and never says it wasn't due, was early or unscheduled, nor turns into a lesson.
The turn names the move and gives the task in two sentences with no demo, menu path, panel name, how-to tips or reteach; the land-hard question is a scope check, not a walkthrough.
Card, Position and 1.2 to 2.4 s all match the snapshot pair "Card › Position 1.2–2.4 s"; no other layer, property or time is mentioned.
